title: Resolve — AI Payment Dispute Agent
blurb: Gemini investigates fictional payment disputes while humans retain refund approval.

beforeAfter.note: Test counts are not coverage percentages. No comparable pre-change holdout baseline exists.

kbFacts.text: Resolve uses Next.js, TypeScript, Gemini native tool use, private PostgREST and Neon Postgres to investigate fictional payment disputes with human refund approval.
Resolve verification includes 194 key-free tests, 35 isolated live Neon integration checks and independently verified public Gemini investigations.
Resolve preserves negative evaluation results: a 16-case automated holdout missed qualitative errors, and a later six-case targeted campaign retained one genuine failed answer.
